summary.text: Steve Baker is a retired Marine and the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Staci Czar.
He won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary by defeating incumbent Michael Davis.

paragraphs.text: Baker said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he served 30 years on active duty and reached the rank of Master Gunnery Sergeant; Ballotpedia lists his Marine Corps service as 1994 to 2024.
He earned a bachelor's degree from American Military University in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.
He said he has been married for 27 years and has six children and three grandchildren.
Baker listed being pro-life, educational freedom and the right to bear arms as his key messages, and named families and veterans as policy interests.
